## Loading data

Every module reads from one shared, in-session dataset. There are two ways to populate it:

1. **Use the preloaded example dataset** — every module works immediately against a built-in example so you can explore the app before bringing your own data. This is the default on first launch.
2. **Upload your own data** — from the **Dataset** tab within Transcriptomics (Chapter \@ref(transcriptomics-dataset)) or Methylomics (Chapter \@ref(methylomics-dataset)), depending on which track you're working in.

